text:
sam: seeing a burst of 502/504s on hosted inference API since ~09:12 UTC, customers reporting timeouts and model failures :grimacing:
elaine: which downstream are we tripping? any cache alerts?
sam: looks like prefix-kv is spiking 500s and conn timeouts to memcached cluster in us-west-2, sample errors from gateway: `upstream prematurely closed connection` and `read timeout`
ops-bot: Incident alert: kv-prefix-memcached latency > 2s for 7m (nodes mcache-3,mcache-4) — alerted to #eng-sre and #eng-infra
jun: grabbing relevant logs, tailing proxy and gateway traces now
sam: pasted a few logs, thx:
```
# gateway log sample
[2026-03-17T09:12:32Z] request_id=0a1b2c path=/v1/generate model=gpt-2b status=502 upstream_error="memcached timeout" latency_ms=1805
[2026-03-17T09:12:33Z] request_id=0a1b2d status=504 reason="prefix-kv read timeout"
```
elaine: customer impact: 5 active customers reported failures (c_1234, c_7890, c_5555). Support ticket numbers: #SUP-4651, #SUP-4652
marta: quick repro steps? can we hit that cache key pattern to reproduce?
sam: yes — route used by hosted inference for model config caching: `prefix:{customer}:{model}:{ver}`. I can run a script to hammer read path but will coordinate with SRE to avoid further P0 impact
jun: checking memcached cluster metrics — connection saturation on mcache-4, retransmits, and elevated tcp retransmit rate. No CPU spike, but fd exhaustion on the connection manager process on that host
ops-bot: Deployment note: a config push at 08:50 modified client-side max_conn from 512 -> 256 (rollback suggested)
elaine: that explains fd exhaustion if many clients scaled up. Any config change events from deploy bot?
ops-bot: Deploy event: config/service/prefix-kv-client updated by infra-ci at 2026-03-17T08:50:12Z (PR #4821)
sam: rolling back that change on the client is top priority — started canary rollback to us-west-2 now
marta: meanwhile, enable read-through fallback: return stale model config from local cache for 2s and queue a background refresh? can we patch quickly?
jun: we can toggle the feature flag to allow local fallback. Pushing flag toggle to hosted API edge now (non-disruptive)
sam: doing controlled retry/backoff bump for memcached client in the runtime too: increase timeout from 100ms -> 300ms and linear backoff 50ms
elaine: watchers: please note exact timeline for postmortem. Customers are on calls. We need: timeline, root cause (config change reduced max_conn), blast radius (us-west-2), mitigation steps, and follow-ups (hard limit in deploy CI for conn changes).
ops-bot: Action assigned: jun -> investigate mcache-4 FD leak; elaine -> customer comms and SLAs; sam -> runtime client rollback PR; marta -> feature flag fallback rollout
sam: immediate mitigations in place: rolled back client config, toggled fallback flag, bumped timeouts. Error rate down from 18% -> 3% in 8 minutes
alertbot: metric update: gateway 5xx rate (us-west-2) decreased from 120r/min to 18r/min after rollback
jun: found stray file descriptor leak in our connection pool destructor on node mcache-4, patch in review (PR #4830). Replacing node to flush state while patch lands
marta: added a short-term guard: if memcached conn failures exceed 5% then circuit-break to fallback and emit SLO-warning metric
elaine: customer comms drafted: "We experienced degraded API availability due to an internal cache client configuration change that reduced connections to the memcached cluster. We've rolled back the change and applied fallbacks. We are investigating and will follow up." Ready to send after legal review
sam: follow-ups: 1) postmortem with timeline + code diff + roll-control 2) enforce CI checks for connection-lowering changes 3) add more memcached pool metrics (fd usage, pending-ops) to alerting 4) consider adaptive client that auto-increases pool on spike with safety caps
jun: ETA on patch merge and node replacement is ~45min, will coordinate maintenance window for node replace (no planned customer downtime)
elaine: assigning postmortem owners: jun + sam. Draft due EOD. I'll notify sales/account teams for impacted customers.
marta: adding automated test to simulate reduced max_conn and verify graceful fallback behavior
sam: one last note — saw a customer with billing anomalies because their request retried multiple times and double-invoiced tokens. Finance: need to reconcile and credit tokens for c_5555. Filing billing ticket #BILL-778
elaine: thanks all. We'll monitor for 2 hours, then move to retrospective. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Incident closed (mitigations applied) — monitoring for regressions
sam: closing thread, will post postmortem link when ready
